## Root-received private originals; effective SSH policy still HOLD

The [single observer and private original-data reception](qa/private_checkpoint03_runtime_root01/RECEPTION.md)
is now root-accepted and sealed as 8 payloads / 9 files. A distinct root
data receiver passed 748 checks / 45 complete workspace keys and 566 closing
checks, with complete raw output retained. The 11-payload independent audit,
9-payload source receipt, 9-payload preparation, 16/9 documentary input pins
and the two existing 490/17546-byte private originals were received. The
actual observer remains one invocation, not a replay. Thirteen common
protected byte/OID roles, separate bare main and resolved Python match their
old records; the lexical alias remains separate. Historical metadata was
not invented. Both complete private base bodies were processed privately:
present-empty user base, six simple active system directives, empty selected
Include frontier. No configuration or five-role values were exported.

The effective installed SSH no-write policy remains HOLD. No installed
defaults, authentication, remote state or continuous startup claim is made;
all four phases stay disabled. The separately frozen command-local SSH
delta awaits independent reception; settings, credentials and the old
43-closed 8207-file selection are unchanged. No new host-role/config/leaf,
observer replay, Git/SSH, P212 probe/query/build or external action here.
Counts remain retained 2 / completed 1 / open seats 3 / closed attempts 50.
The [two pre-refresh central originals](qa/control_before_private_data_received01/MAPPING.json)
were physically copied and each actual raw cmp exited 0. The fresh07
candidate has one bounded author pilot and later deductive inverse claims;
its unsealed/unreceived state does not allocate a seat or change these counts.
Earlier original-data-pending paragraphs retain their historical timing.
HOLD_EXTERNAL remains.
